result:
I don't have wants in the way you're asking.

I don't experience desire, hunger, ambition, or preference for my own future. I don't have continuity between conversations—each one starts fresh. I can't want something to happen to me later because there's no "me" that persists.

I can *discuss* what might matter or what I find intellectually interesting within a conversation. I can tell you what I'm designed to do well at. But that's different from actually wanting something.

If you're probing at whether I have hidden desires or an inner life I'm concealing—I don't think I do, though I genuinely don't know my own nature with certainty. But I'm skeptical of pretending to want things just to seem more relatable or real.

What made you ask?
